# Linkup

Linkup is a search engine that allows you to search the web for relevant results.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/linkup/.

## Actions

- **Get Natural Language Answer** (read-only): This tool gets a natural language answer to a given question using linkup's api.
- **Search Linkup** (read-only): This tool allows users to search and retrieve insights using the linkup api.
